title: Create plan
firstDescription: Define the plan, then complete its capabilities and limits in the detail page.
stepLimits: Configure capabilities and limits later in the detail page.
sectionHelp: Enter the slug, display name and an optional description.
slugHelp: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; start and end with a letter or number.
noAccess: You do not have permission to create plans
noAccessDescription: Your values are retained. Return to the catalog to view the available plans.
notFoundDescription: Your values are retained. Return to the catalog and try again later.
errorMessage: Your values are retained. Retry creation or edit the form.
outcomeUnknown: We could not confirm whether the plan was created. Check the catalog before retrying: another attempt could create a duplicate.
conflict: A plan with this slug already exists. Change the slug before creating the plan.
badRequest: The plan data is invalid. Check the fields before creating the plan.
